question: Which of the following refers to the transfer of ownership, management and control of public sector enterprises to private sector entrepreneurs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Privatization**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Privatization** refers to the process of transferring ownership, management, and control of public sector enterprises to private sector entities.
 
• It is often implemented to improve efficiency, productivity, and profitability of the enterprises.
 
• Privatization can involve the sale of government-owned assets to private investors or the outsourcing of services previously provided by the public sector.
